### Loading Acoustic Data

```{r}
library(seewave)
library(tuneR)
library(dplyr)

# Define base paths for each habitat type
forest_base <- "/Volumes/1 Backup/Soundscapes_Summer25_AS/Acoustic_Indices/WAV_Chunks/Macro_Forest"
barren_base <- "/Volumes/1 Backup/Soundscapes_Summer25_AS/Acoustic_Indices/WAV_Chunks/Urchin_Barren"

# Define sites with their habitat type and subfolder
site_info <- data.frame(
  site = c("Battery_Island", "Crow_Island", "Middle_Island",
           "Harris_Island", "Samsing_Cove", "Sandy_Cove"),
  habitat = c("Macro_Forest", "Macro_Forest", "Macro_Forest",
              "Urchin_Barren", "Urchin_Barren", "Urchin_Barren"),
  subfolder = c("HydroMoth_0",   # Battery_Island
                "HydroMoth_0.5", # Crow_Island 
                "HydroMoth_2",   # Middle_Island 
                "HydroMoth_12",    # Harris_Island 
                "HydroMoth_6",    # Samsing_Cove 
                "HydroMoth_15"),   # Sandy_Cove 
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Build full paths automatically
site_info <- site_info %>%
  mutate(
    base = ifelse(habitat == "Macro_Forest", forest_base, barren_base),
    full_path = file.path(base, site, subfolder)
  )

# Check all paths exist before running
site_info$path_exists <- sapply(site_info$full_path, dir.exists)
print(site_info[, c("site", "habitat", "full_path", "path_exists")])
```

### Temporal Entropy

```{r}
calc_site_ht <- function(site_name, base_dir, n_sample = NULL) {
  
  # Get all wav files for this site
  site_path <- file.path(base_dir, site_name)
  files <- list.files(site_path, pattern = "\\.wav$", 
                      full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  

  # Calculate Ht for each file
  ht_values <- sapply(files, function(f) {
    tryCatch({
      wav <- readWave(f)
      envelope <- env(wav, f = wav@samp.rate, plot = FALSE)
      th(envelope)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("  Error on:", basename(f), "\n")
      return(NA)
    })
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  
  # Return summary
  data.frame(
    site = site_name,
    n_files = length(files),
    n_success = sum(!is.na(ht_values)),
    Ht_mean = mean(ht_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ht_sd = sd(ht_values, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ht_median = median(ht_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(readr)
# Core function — stratified by hour, 10 files per hour
calc_ht_stratified <- function(site_name, full_path, files_per_hour = 10) {
  
  cat("\n=============================\n")
  cat("Processing:", site_name, "\n")
  cat("Path:", full_path, "\n")
  
  # Get all wav files
  files <- list.files(full_path, pattern = "\\.wav$", 
                      full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    cat("  WARNING: No wav files found!\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("  Total files found:", length(files), "\n")
  
  # Extract hour from filename (format: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS)
  hours <- as.integer(substr(gsub(".*_(\\d{6})_.*", "\\1", 
                                   basename(files)), 1, 2))
  
  file_df <- data.frame(path = files, hour = hours)
  
  # Sample 10 files per hour
  sampled <- file_df %>%
    group_by(hour) %>%
    slice_sample(n = files_per_hour) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  cat("  Sampled files:", nrow(sampled), 
      "across", n_distinct(sampled$hour), "hours\n")
  
  # Calculate Ht for each sampled file
  results <- lapply(1:nrow(sampled), function(i) {
    f <- sampled$path[i]
    tryCatch({
      wav <- readWave(f)
      envelope <- env(wav, f = wav@samp.rate, plot = FALSE)
      ht <- th(envelope)
      data.frame(site = site_name, hour = sampled$hour[i],
                 file = basename(f), Ht = ht)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("  Error:", basename(f), "-", e$message, "\n")
      data.frame(site = site_name, hour = sampled$hour[i],
                 file = basename(f), Ht = NA)
    })
  })
  
  bind_rows(results)
}

# Run all 6 sites, saving after each one
all_results <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(site_info)) {
  site_results <- calc_ht_stratified(
    site_name = site_info$site[i],
    full_path = site_info$full_path[i],
    files_per_hour = 10
  )
  
  all_results[[site_info$site[i]]] <- site_results
  
  # Save after each site in case of crashes
  write_csv(bind_rows(all_results), "Ht_results_progress.csv")
  cat("  Saved progress for", site_info$site[i], "\n")
}

# Final summary per site
summary_results <- bind_rows(all_results) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    n_files   = n(),
    Ht_mean   = mean(Ht, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ht_sd     = sd(Ht, na.rm = TRUE),
    Ht_median = median(Ht, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(summary_results)
write_csv(summary_results, "Ht_summary_by_site.csv")
write_csv(bind_rows(all_results), "Ht_all_files.csv")
```

```{r}
# Approximate Df using the distribution summary statistics per site
site_summaries <- all_spectral %>%
  filter(datetime >= as.POSIXct("2025-07-23 23:59:43", tz = "UTC"),
         datetime <= as.POSIXct("2025-07-28 23:59:32", tz = "UTC")) %>%
  group_by(SITE) %>%
  summarise(across(c(MEAN, SD, MEDIAN, MODE, Q25, Q75, 
                     IQR, SKEW, KURT, SFM, SH),
                   mean, na.rm = TRUE))

# Scale
library(tibble)
site_matrix <- site_summaries %>%
  column_to_rownames("SITE") %>%
  scale()

# Euclidean distance as proxy for Df
library(vegan)
Df_approx <- vegdist(site_matrix, method = "euclidean")
print(as.matrix(round(Df_approx, 4)))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

# Calculate dissimilarity matrix from site summaries
site_summaries <- all_spectral %>%
  group_by(SITE) %>%
  summarise(across(c(MEAN, SD, MEDIAN, MODE, Q25, Q75,
                     IQR, SKEW, KURT, SFM, SH),
                   mean, na.rm = TRUE))

site_matrix <- site_summaries %>%
  column_to_rownames("SITE") %>%
  scale()

Df_approx <- vegdist(site_matrix, method = "euclidean")
Df_mat <- as.matrix(round(Df_approx, 4))

# Add habitat labels to site names for clarity
rownames(Df_mat) <- colnames(Df_mat) <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(Df_mat))

# Melt for ggplot
Df_long <- melt(Df_mat, varnames = c("Site1", "Site2"), value.name = "Dissimilarity")

# Add habitat for ordering
habitat_order <- c("Battery Island", "Crow Island", "Middle Island",
                   "Harris Island", "Samsing Cove", "Sandy Cove")

Df_long$Site1 <- factor(Df_long$Site1, levels = habitat_order)
Df_long$Site2 <- factor(Df_long$Site2, levels = habitat_order)

# Plot
ggplot(Df_long, aes(x = Site1, y = Site2, fill = Dissimilarity)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Dissimilarity, 2)), size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f7fbff", high = "#08306b") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 3.5, ymin = 0.5, ymax = 3.5,
           fill = NA, color = "blue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 3.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = 3.5, ymax = 6.5,
           fill = NA, color = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Spectral Dissimilarity Between Sites",
    subtitle = "Blue = Macro Forest | Red = Urchin Barren",
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    fill = "Dissimilarity"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9)
  )

ggsave("spectral_dissimilarity_heatmap.png", width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

# Make sure factors are set
all_spectral <- all_spectral %>%
  mutate(
    habitat = factor(habitat, levels = c("Macro_Forest", "Urchin_Barren")),
    SITE    = factor(SITE),
    date    = as.Date(datetime, tz = "UTC")
  )

# Run one LMM per index
indices <- c("MEAN", "SD", "MEDIAN", "MODE", "Q25", "Q75",
             "IQR", "SKEW", "KURT", "SFM", "SH")

lmm_results <- lapply(indices, function(idx) {
  
  # Fixed effect: habitat
  # Random effects: site nested within habitat, date as crossed random effect
  formula <- as.formula(paste(idx, "~ habitat + (1 | habitat/SITE) + (1 | date)"))
  
  model <- tryCatch(
    lmer(formula, data = all_spectral, REML = FALSE),
    error = function(e) { cat("Error in", idx, ":", e$message, "\n"); NULL }
  )
  
  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
  
  data.frame(
    index     = idx,
    term      = rownames(coefs),
    estimate  = coefs[, "Estimate"],
    std_error = coefs[, "Std. Error"],
    t_value   = coefs[, "t value"],
    p_value   = coefs[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
    row.names = NULL
  )
})

# Combine
lmm_table <- do.call(rbind, lmm_results) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      p_value < 0.1   ~ ".",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    )
  )

# Filter to just habitat effect for summary
habitat_results <- lmm_table %>%
  filter(term == "habitatUrchin_Barren")

cat("\nHabitat effect on each index:\n")
print(habitat_results)

write.csv(lmm_table,       "lmm_full_results.csv",    row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(habitat_results, "lmm_habitat_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

habitat_results %>%
  select(index, estimate, std_error, t_value, p_value, sig) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))) %>%
  print(n = 11)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Build full habitat results table including SH
habitat_results <- lmm_table %>%
  filter(term == "habitatUrchin_Barren") %>%
  mutate(
    # Add units for context
    index = factor(index, levels = rev(c("MEAN", "MEDIAN", "MODE", "Q25", 
                                          "Q75", "IQR", "SD", "SKEW", 
                                          "KURT", "SFM", "SH"))),
    sig_label = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      p_value < 0.1   ~ ".",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    significant = p_value < 0.05
  )

# Standardize estimates by dividing by std_error (effect in SE units)
# so all indices are on comparable scale
habitat_results <- habitat_results %>%
  mutate(
    std_estimate = estimate / std_error,
    std_lower    = std_estimate - 1.96,
    std_upper    = std_estimate + 1.96
  )

ggplot(habitat_results, aes(x = std_estimate, y = index, 
                             color = significant)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = std_lower, xmax = std_upper),
                 height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), 
            nudge_x = 0.3, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "gray60", "TRUE" = "#2166ac"),
                     labels = c("ns", "p < 0.05")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Effect of Habitat on Spectral Acoustic Indices",
    subtitle = "Estimate = Urchin Barren relative to Macro Forest (in SE units)\n±1.96 SE shown",
    x        = "Standardized Estimate (SE units)",
    y        = "Spectral Index",
    color    = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 11)
  )

ggsave("lmm_coefficient_plot.png", width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: lmm_coefficient_plot.png\n")
```

```{r}
pca <- prcomp(site_matrix, scale. = FALSE)  # already scaled

# Variance explained
var_exp <- round(summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100, 1)
cat("PC1:", var_exp[1], "%  PC2:", var_exp[2], "%\n")

# Site scores
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2])
pca_scores$site    <- rownames(pca_scores)
pca_scores$habitat <- case_when(
  pca_scores$site %in% c("Battery_Island", "Crow_Island", "Middle_Island") ~ "Macro Forest",
  pca_scores$site %in% c("Harris_Island",  "Samsing_Cove", "Sandy_Cove")  ~ "Urchin Barren"
)
pca_scores$site_label <- gsub("_", " ", pca_scores$site)

# Index loadings
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2])
loadings$index <- rownames(loadings)

# Scale arrows for plotting
arrow_scale <- 2
loadings$PC1_scaled <- loadings$PC1 * arrow_scale
loadings$PC2_scaled <- loadings$PC2 * arrow_scale

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1_scaled, yend = PC2_scaled),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = loadings,
            aes(x = PC1_scaled * 1.15, y = PC2_scaled * 1.15, label = index),
            size = 3.5, color = "gray20") +
  geom_point(data = pca_scores,
             aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = habitat, shape = habitat),
             size = 5) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = pca_scores,
                             aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, 
                                 label = site_label, color = habitat),
                             size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Macro Forest"  = "blue",
                                "Urchin Barren" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title    = "PCA of Spectral Acoustic Indices",
    subtitle = paste0("PC1: ", var_exp[1], "%  |  PC2: ", var_exp[2], "%"),
    x        = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
    y        = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)"),
    color    = "Habitat",
    shape    = "Habitat"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave("pca_spectral.png", width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: pca_spectral.png\n")
```

```{r}
# SVM with the same JMP Parameters

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(kernlab)

BARREN_LABEL <- "Barren"
FOREST_LABEL <- "Macro_Forest"
predictors   <- c("MEAN", "SD", "SEM", "MEDIAN", "MODE", "Q25", "Q75", "IQR","SKEW", "KURT", "SFM", "SH")
type_col     <- "TYPE"

# Prep data 
all_spectral_keep_rows  <- complete.cases(all_spectral[, c(predictors, type_col)])
all_spectral_data <- all_spectral[all_spectral_keep_rows, ]
all_spectral_data[[type_col]] <- factor(all_spectral_data[[type_col]],
                                  levels = c(BARREN_LABEL, FOREST_LABEL))

cat("Total rows used:", nrow(all_spectral_data), "\n")
cat("Class counts:\n")
print(table(all_spectral_data[[type_col]]))

write.csv(all_spectral_data, "all_spectral_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Train SVM (cost = C = 1, gamma = sigma = 0.25, RBF kernel)
all_spectral_svm_formula <- as.formula(paste("TYPE ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))

all_spectral_svm_model <- ksvm(
  all_spectral_svm_formula,
  data       = all_spectral_data,
  kernel     = "rbfdot",
  kpar       = list(sigma = 0.25),
  C          = 1,
  prob.model = TRUE,
  scaled     = TRUE
)

cat("\n--- Model Summary ---\n")
cat("Kernel:                   Radial Basis Function\n")
cat("Cost (C):                ", 1, "\n")
cat("Gamma (sigma):           ", 0.25, "\n")
cat("Number of Support Vectors:", all_spectral_svm_model@nSV, "\n")

# 3. Training predictions & confusion matrix 
train_pred <- predict(all_spectral_svm_model, newdata = all_spectral_data)
stopifnot(length(train_pred) == nrow(all_spectral_data))

conf_mat  <- table(Actual = all_spectral_data[[type_col]], Predicted = train_pred)
conf_rate <- prop.table(conf_mat, margin = 1)

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (Counts) ---\n")
print(conf_mat)
cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (Predicted Rates) ---\n")
print(round(conf_rate, 3))

misclass_rate <- 1 - sum(diag(conf_mat)) / sum(conf_mat)
cat("\nMisclassification Rate:", round(misclass_rate, 7), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Wrap predict function for iml
pred_fun <- function(model, newdata) {
  as.numeric(predict(model, newdata = newdata))
}

# Build predictor object
predictor <- Predictor$new(
  model            = all_spectral_svm_model,          
  data             = all_spectral_data[, predictors], 
  y                = all_spectral_data$TYPE,            
  predict.function = pred_fun
)

# Calculate permutation importance
importance <- FeatureImp$new(predictor, loss = "ce")   # ce = cross entropy for classification

# Plot
plot(importance)

importance$results
```

```{r}
library(broom)

# Fit multiple models
lm_lin  <- lm(mean_gradient_score ~ red_urchin_density, data = density_svm)
lm_log  <- lm(mean_gradient_score ~ log(red_urchin_density + 0.01), data = density_svm)
lm_sqrt <- lm(mean_gradient_score ~ sqrt(red_urchin_density), data = density_svm)
lm_quad <- lm(mean_gradient_score ~ red_urchin_density + I(red_urchin_density^2), data = density_svm)
lm_pow  <- lm(log(mean_gradient_score) ~ log(red_urchin_density + 0.01), data = density_svm)

# Compare AIC and R2
model_comparison <- data.frame(
  model   = c("Linear", "Log", "Square Root", "Quadratic", "Power"),
  R2      = c(summary(lm_lin)$r.squared,
              summary(lm_log)$r.squared,
              summary(lm_sqrt)$r.squared,
              summary(lm_quad)$r.squared,
              summary(lm_pow)$r.squared),
  AIC     = c(AIC(lm_lin), AIC(lm_log), AIC(lm_sqrt), 
              AIC(lm_quad), AIC(lm_pow)),
  p_value = c(summary(lm_lin)$coefficients[2, 4],
              summary(lm_log)$coefficients[2, 4],
              summary(lm_sqrt)$coefficients[2, 4],
              summary(lm_quad)$coefficients[2, 4],
              summary(lm_pow)$coefficients[2, 4])
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(AIC)

print(model_comparison)

# Plot all curves together
x_seq <- seq(0, max(density_svm$red_urchin_density) * 1.05, length.out = 200)

pred_df <- data.frame(
  x      = rep(x_seq, 5),
  y      = c(
    predict(lm_lin,  newdata = data.frame(red_urchin_density = x_seq)),
    predict(lm_log,  newdata = data.frame(red_urchin_density = x_seq)),
    predict(lm_sqrt, newdata = data.frame(red_urchin_density = x_seq)),
    predict(lm_quad, newdata = data.frame(red_urchin_density = x_seq)),
    exp(predict(lm_pow, newdata = data.frame(red_urchin_density = x_seq)))
  ),
  model  = rep(c("Linear", "Log", "Square Root", "Quadratic", "Power"), 
               each = length(x_seq))
)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = density_svm,
             aes(x = red_urchin_density, y = mean_gradient_score, color = SITE),
             size = 4) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df,
            aes(x = x, y = y, linetype = model),
            linewidth = 0.8, color = "gray30") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Model Fit Comparison",
    x        = "Red urchin density",
    y        = "Probability of assignment as Urchin Barrens (SVM)",
    linetype = "Model fit",
    color    = "Site"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave("svm_curve_comparison.png", width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(here)
# Read in data

type_col     <- "TYPE"

cat("Number of Support Vectors:", cca_urchin_spectral_svm_model@nSV, "\n")

# Training predictions & confusion matrix

cca_urchin_spectral_conf_mat   <- table(Actual = cca_urchin_spectral_measurements_model$TYPE, Predicted = cca_urchin_spectral_train_pred)
cca_urchin_spectral_conf_rate  <- prop.table(cca_urchin_spectral_conf_mat, margin = 1)

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (Counts) ---\n")

cat("\n--- Confusion Matrix (Predicted Rates) ---\n")

cca_urchin_spectral_misclass_rate <- 1 - sum(diag(cca_urchin_spectral_conf_mat)) / sum(cca_urchin_spectral_conf_mat)
cat("\nMisclassification Rate:", round(cca_urchin_spectral_misclass_rate, 7), "\n")

# 5-fold cross validation
set.seed(123)
cca_urchin_spectral_svm_cv <- kernlab::ksvm(
  TYPE ~ MEAN + SD + SEM + MEDIAN + Q25 + Q75 + IQR + SKEW + KURT + SFM +SH ,
  data       = cca_urchin_spectral_measurements_model,
  kernel     = "rbfdot",
  kpar       = "automatic",
  C          = 1,
  cross      = 5,
  scaled     = TRUE
)
cat("5-fold CV error:", kernlab::cross(cca_urchin_spectral_svm_cv), "\n")
cat("5-fold CV accuracy:", 1 - kernlab::cross(cca_urchin_spectral_svm_cv), "\n")
```

```{r}
rock_urchin_spectral_measurements <- read.csv("/Users/aminashenasa/soundscapes_data/data/acoustic_data/filtered_data/Rock_Spectral_Measurements.csv")

ROCK_URCHIN_LABEL    <- "URCHINS_BARE ROCK"
ROCK_NO_URCHIN_LABEL <- "NO URCHINS_BARE ROCK"
predictors   <- c("MEAN", "SD", "SEM", "MEDIAN", "Q25", "Q75", "IQR","SKEW", "KURT", "SFM", "SH")

rock_urchin_spectral_measurements_model[[type_col]] <- factor(
  rock_urchin_spectral_measurements_model[[type_col]],

)

  kpar       = "automatic",
  C          = 1,
  prob.model = TRUE,
  scaled     = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# Step 1 — predict all three urchin SVMs onto full habitat_model_data
cca_spectral_probs_full  <- predict(cca_urchin_spectral_svm_model,  newdata = data.frame(
  ACI  = habitat_model_data$ACI,
  NDSI = habitat_model_data$NDSI), 
  type = "probabilities")[, "URCHIN_CCA"]

rock_spectral_probs_full <- predict(rock_urchin_spectral_svm_model, newdata = data.frame(
  ACI  = as.numeric(habitat_model_data$ACI),
  NDSI = as.numeric(habitat_model_data$NDSI)),
  type = "probabilities")[, "URCHINS_BARE_ROCK"]

kelp_spectral_probs_full <- predict(kelp_urchin_spectral_svm_model, newdata = data.frame(
  ACI  = habitat_model_data$ACI,
  NDSI = habitat_model_data$NDSI),
  type = "probabilities")[, "URCHIN_KELP"]

# Step 2 — combine into one dataframe and run PCA
urchin_prob_df <- data.frame(
  cca_prob  = cca_probs_full,
  rock_prob = rock_probs_full,
  kelp_prob = kelp_probs_full
)

urchin_pca  <- prcomp(urchin_prob_df, scale. = TRUE)
summary(urchin_pca)

# Step 3 — extract PC1 (negating pc1 as well)
pc1_scores <- -urchin_pca$x[, "PC1"]

# Step 4 — get habitat SVM probabilities for full model_data
habitat_probs <- predict(habitat_svm_model, newdata = habitat_model_data, type = "probabilities")
prob_barren_all <- habitat_probs[, "Barren"]

# Step 5 — regress and plot
pc1_df <- data.frame(
  pc1         = pc1_scores,
  prob_barren = prob_barren_all
)

lm_pc1 <- lm(prob_barren ~ pc1, data = pc1_df)
summary(lm_pc1)

# Plot
ggplot(pc1_df, aes(x = pc1, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "steelblue", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = min(pc1_df$pc1),
           y     = max(pc1_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(summary(lm_pc1)$r.squared, 3),
                          ", P = ", format(summary(lm_pc1)$coefficients[2, 4],
                                           scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "More Urchin Noise (PC1)",
    y = "Probability of Assignment as Urchin Barrens (SVM)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
p_cca <- ggplot(cca_df, aes(x = cca_prob, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.03, color = "grey40") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "steelblue", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = min(cca_df$cca_prob), y = max(cca_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(summary(lm_cca)$r.squared, 3),
                          ", P = ", format(summary(lm_cca)$coefficients[2, 4], scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "P(URCHIN_CCA)", y = "P(Barren)", title = "CCA vs Barren")
print(p_cca)

# ---- Rock vs prob_barren ----
rock_df <- data.frame(rock_prob = rock_spectral_probs_full, prob_barren = prob_barren_all)
lm_rock <- lm(prob_barren ~ rock_prob, data = rock_df)
cat("\n=== Rock vs prob_barren ===\n")
print(summary(lm_rock))

p_rock <- ggplot(rock_df, aes(x = rock_prob, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.03, color = "grey40") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "steelblue", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = min(rock_df$rock_prob), y = max(rock_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(summary(lm_rock)$r.squared, 3),
                          ", P = ", format(summary(lm_rock)$coefficients[2, 4], scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "P(URCHINS_BARE ROCK)", y = "P(Barren)", title = "Rock vs Barren")
print(p_rock)

# ---- Kelp vs prob_barren ----
kelp_df <- data.frame(kelp_prob = kelp_spectral_probs_full, prob_barren = prob_barren_all)
lm_kelp <- lm(prob_barren ~ kelp_prob, data = kelp_df)
cat("\n=== Kelp vs prob_barren ===\n")
print(summary(lm_kelp))

p_kelp <- ggplot(kelp_df, aes(x = kelp_prob, y = prob_barren)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.03, color = "grey40") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "steelblue", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = min(kelp_df$kelp_prob), y = max(kelp_df$prob_barren),
           label = paste0("R² = ", round(summary(lm_kelp)$r.squared, 3),
                          ", P = ", format(summary(lm_kelp)$coefficients[2, 4], scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5, size = 4.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "P(URCHIN_KELP)", y = "P(Barren)", title = "Kelp vs Barren")
print(p_kelp)

# Quick R² comparison summary
cat("\n=== R² summary ===\n")
cat("CCA:  R² =", round(summary(lm_cca)$r.squared, 4), "\n")
cat("Rock: R² =", round(summary(lm_rock)$r.squared, 4), "\n")
cat("Kelp: R² =", round(summary(lm_kelp)$r.squared, 4), "\n")
```
